project.name: Inspecto — cross-space exchange / sharing (Standard edition, optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL Standard-edition cross-space Exchange (EDITIONS.md SEC-10, "Exchange / sharing grants between spaces"): the com.gamma.exchange domain (offers, share grants, snapshots, ledger) plus ExchangeRoutes (11 routes under /exchange, six of them capability-gated) contributed through the core's public com.gamma.control.RouteModule ServiceLoader seam, and ExchangeRefResolver, which installs the core's com.gamma.query.SharedRefResolver singleton so DatasetRelation can resolve shared/<owner>/<item> refs.
WHY THIS MODULE EXISTS (EDG-01 cell 4, 2026-09-07). SEC-10 was decided "not for Personal" on 2026-09-02 and all of it shipped in every bundle because it sat in the core. Dropping THIS jar on the classpath is what makes the 11 paths exist and what installs the shared-ref resolver; without it the core answers those paths with 503 "not installed" (AbsentExchangeRoutes), /bootstrap reports features.exchange=false, and SharedRefResolver stays NONE so every shared ref fails closed.
⚠ The six /exchange capability entries stay in the core's CapabilityManifest by decision: deriving the grantable vocabulary from registered routes would make a role file authored on Standard fail validation on Personal. Dead vocabulary is not a hole — there is no route behind it.
THIN, like inspecto-policy: nothing beyond what the core already supplies. Built only under the "edition-standard"/"edition-enterprise" profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal, the DEFAULT build) never compiles or tests it.
